request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Recolour only the dark brown leather: his two big gauntlets, the shoulder straps, the belt and the trousers become pale sand-buff leather, colour #d0b073, shaded #9a7a46, not dark and not orange; the boots become mid brown, colour #8a5a30. Keep everything else exactly the same: the green skin, open shouting mouth, tusks, eyes, beard, horned tin helmet, cream fur mantle, yellow megaphone, pose, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
